turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Today: the 1908 Tunguska explosion. One witness at the trading post put it this way: "At breakfast the sky split in two."
citations: {{claim:At breakfast the sky split in two.}}

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Independent sources agree that in June 1908 an explosion flattened about 80 million trees.
citations: {{claim:In June 1908 an explosion flattened about 80 million trees over the Tunguska forest.}}

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One source, the expedition, reports that no impact crater was found: "No impact crater was found."
